verses.greek: Ἀγαπητοί, μὴ παντὶ πνεύματι πιστεύετε, ἀλλὰ δοκιμάζετε τὰ πνεύματα εἰ ἐκ τοῦ θεοῦ ἐστιν, ὅτι πολλοὶ ψευδοπροφῆται ἐξεληλύθασιν εἰς τὸν κόσμον.
verses.literal: Beloved not every spirit do believe but do test the spirits whether of the God they are because many false prophets have gone out into the world.
verses.dgt: Beloved, do not believe every spirit, but test the spirits to see whether they are from God, because many false prophets have gone out into the world.

verses.greek: ἐν τούτῳ γινώσκετε τὸ πνεῦμα τοῦ θεοῦ· πᾶν πνεῦμα ὃ ὁμολογεῖ Ἰησοῦν Χριστὸν ἐν σαρκὶ ἐληλυθότα ἐκ τοῦ θεοῦ ἐστιν,
verses.literal: By this you know the Spirit the of God: Every spirit that confesses Jesus Christ in the flesh having come of the God is.
verses.dgt: By this you know the Spirit of God: every spirit that confesses Jesus Christ as having come in the flesh is from God,

verses.greek: καὶ πᾶν πνεῦμα ὃ μὴ ὁμολογεῖ τὸν Ἰησοῦν ἐκ τοῦ θεοῦ οὐκ ἔστιν· καὶ τοῦτό ἐστιν τὸ τοῦ ἀντιχρίστου, ὃ ἀκηκόατε ὅτι ἔρχεται, καὶ νῦν ἐν τῷ κόσμῳ ἐστὶν ἤδη.
verses.literal: and any spirit that not confesses the Jesus in the God not is And this is that of the antichrist which you have heard that is coming and now in the world is already.
verses.dgt: and every spirit that does not confess Jesus is not from God. And this is the spirit of the antichrist, which you heard is coming, and now is already in the world.

verses.greek: ὑμεῖς ἐκ τοῦ θεοῦ ἐστε, τεκνία, καὶ νενικήκατε αὐτούς, ὅτι μείζων ἐστὶν ὁ ἐν ὑμῖν ἢ ὁ ἐν τῷ κόσμῳ·
verses.literal: you yourselves from the God are little children and have overcome them because greater is the One in you than the one in the world.
verses.dgt: You are from God, little children, and you have overcome them, because the one who is in you is greater than the one who is in the world.

verses.greek: αὐτοὶ ἐκ τοῦ κόσμου εἰσίν· διὰ τοῦτο ἐκ τοῦ κόσμου λαλοῦσιν καὶ ὁ κόσμος αὐτῶν ἀκούει.
verses.literal: They themselves of the world are because of this from out of the world they speak and the world to them listens.
verses.dgt: They are from the world; for this reason they speak from the world, and the world listens to them.

verses.greek: ἡμεῖς ἐκ τοῦ θεοῦ ἐσμεν· ὁ γινώσκων τὸν θεὸν ἀκούει ἡμῶν, ὃς οὐκ ἔστιν ἐκ τοῦ θεοῦ οὐκ ἀκούει ἡμῶν. ἐκ τούτου γινώσκομεν τὸ πνεῦμα τῆς ἀληθείας καὶ τὸ πνεῦμα τῆς πλάνης.
verses.literal: We ourselves of the God are The one knowing the God listens to us He who not is from the God not listens to us. By this we know the Spirit the of truth and the spirit the of falsehood.
verses.dgt: We are from God. The one who knows God listens to us; whoever is not from God does not listen to us. From this we know the Spirit of truth and the spirit of error.

verses.greek: Ἀγαπητοί, ἀγαπῶμεν ἀλλήλους, ὅτι ἡ ἀγάπη ἐκ τοῦ θεοῦ ἐστιν, καὶ πᾶς ὁ ἀγαπῶν ἐκ τοῦ θεοῦ γεγέννηται καὶ γινώσκει τὸν θεόν.
verses.literal: Beloved we may love one another because the love from the God is and everyone who is loving from the God has been born and knows the God
verses.dgt: Beloved, let us love one another, because love is from God, and everyone who loves has been born from God and knows God.

verses.greek: ὁ μὴ ἀγαπῶν οὐκ ἔγνω τὸν θεόν, ὅτι ὁ θεὸς ἀγάπη ἐστίν.
verses.literal: The one not loving not has known the God because the God love is.
verses.dgt: The one who does not love has not known God, because God is love.

verses.greek: ἐν τούτῳ ἐφανερώθη ἡ ἀγάπη τοῦ θεοῦ ἐν ἡμῖν, ὅτι τὸν υἱὸν αὐτοῦ τὸν μονογενῆ ἀπέσταλκεν ὁ θεὸς εἰς τὸν κόσμον ἵνα ζήσωμεν διʼ αὐτοῦ.
verses.literal: In this has been revealed the love the of God among us that the Son of Him the one and only has sent the God into the world so that we may live through Him.
verses.dgt: By this the love of God was revealed among us: God has sent his unique Son into the world so that we might live through him.

verses.greek: ἐν τούτῳ ἐστὶν ἡ ἀγάπη, οὐχ ὅτι ἡμεῖς ἠγαπήκαμεν τὸν θεόν, ἀλλʼ ὅτι αὐτὸς ἠγάπησεν ἡμᾶς καὶ ἀπέστειλεν τὸν υἱὸν αὐτοῦ ἱλασμὸν περὶ τῶν ἁμαρτιῶν ἡμῶν.
verses.literal: In this is the love not that we ourselves have loved the God but that He himself loved us and He sent the Son of Him as a propitiation for the sins of us.
verses.dgt: In this is love: not that we loved God, but that he loved us and sent his Son as an atoning sacrifice for our sins.

verses.greek: ἀγαπητοί, εἰ οὕτως ὁ θεὸς ἠγάπησεν ἡμᾶς, καὶ ἡμεῖς ὀφείλομεν ἀλλήλους ἀγαπᾶν.
verses.literal: Beloved if so the God loved us also we ourselves ought one another to love
verses.dgt: Beloved, if God loved us in this way, we also ought to love one another.

verses.greek: θεὸν οὐδεὶς πώποτε τεθέαται· ἐὰν ἀγαπῶμεν ἀλλήλους, ὁ θεὸς ἐν ἡμῖν μένει καὶ ἡ ἀγάπη αὐτοῦ ἐν ἡμῖν τετελειωμένη ἐστιν.
verses.literal: God no one at any time has seen if we shall love one another the God in us abides and the love of Him in us perfected is.
verses.dgt: No one has ever seen God. If we love one another, God remains in us, and his love has been brought to completion in us.

verses.greek: Ἐν τούτῳ γινώσκομεν ὅτι ἐν αὐτῷ μένομεν καὶ αὐτὸς ἐν ἡμῖν, ὅτι ἐκ τοῦ πνεύματος αὐτοῦ δέδωκεν ἡμῖν.
verses.literal: By this we know that in Him we abide and He in us because from out the Spirit of Him He has given to us.
verses.dgt: By this we know that we remain in him and he in us: because he has given us from his Spirit.

verses.greek: καὶ ἡμεῖς τεθεάμεθα καὶ μαρτυροῦμεν ὅτι ὁ πατὴρ ἀπέσταλκεν τὸν υἱὸν σωτῆρα τοῦ κόσμου.
verses.literal: And we ourselves have seen and testify that the Father has sent the Son as Savior of the world.
verses.dgt: And we have seen and testify that the Father has sent the Son as Savior of the world.

verses.greek: ὃς ἐὰν ὁμολογήσῃ ὅτι Ἰησοῦς ἐστιν ὁ υἱὸς τοῦ θεοῦ, ὁ θεὸς ἐν αὐτῷ μένει καὶ αὐτὸς ἐν τῷ θεῷ.
verses.literal: Whoever maybe shall confess that Jesus is the Son the of God the God in him abides and he in the God.
verses.dgt: Whoever confesses that Jesus is the Son of God, God remains in him and he in God.

verses.greek: καὶ ἡμεῖς ἐγνώκαμεν καὶ πεπιστεύκαμεν τὴν ἀγάπην ἣν ἔχει ὁ θεὸς ἐν ἡμῖν. Ὁ θεὸς ἀγάπη ἐστίν, καὶ ὁ μένων ἐν τῇ ἀγάπῃ ἐν τῷ θεῷ μένει καὶ ὁ θεὸς ἐν αὐτῷ μένει.
verses.literal: And we ourselves have come to know and we have come to believe the love that has the God as to us. the God love is and the one abiding in the love in the God abides and the God in him abides.
verses.dgt: And we have come to know and have believed the love that God has in us. God is love, and the one who remains in love remains in God, and God remains in him.

verses.greek: ἐν τούτῳ τετελείωται ἡ ἀγάπη μεθʼ ἡμῶν, ἵνα παρρησίαν ἔχωμεν ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ τῆς κρίσεως, ὅτι καθὼς ἐκεῖνός ἐστιν καὶ ἡμεῖς ἐσμεν ἐν τῷ κόσμῳ τούτῳ.
verses.literal: In this has been perfected the love with us so that confidence we may have in the day the of judgment that even as He is also we ourselves are in the world this.
verses.dgt: By this love has been brought to completion with us, so that we may have confidence on the day of judgment, because just as he is, so also are we in this world.

verses.greek: φόβος οὐκ ἔστιν ἐν τῇ ἀγάπῃ, ἀλλʼ ἡ τελεία ἀγάπη ἔξω βάλλει τὸν φόβον, ὅτι ὁ φόβος κόλασιν ἔχει, ὁ δὲ φοβούμενος οὐ τετελείωται ἐν τῇ ἀγάπῃ.
verses.literal: Fear no there is in the love but the perfect love out casts the fear because the fear punishment has the one now fearing not has been perfected in the love.
verses.dgt: There is no fear in love, but complete love drives out fear, because fear involves punishment; and the one who fears has not been brought to completion in love.

verses.greek: ἡμεῖς ἀγαπῶμεν, ὅτι αὐτὸς πρῶτος ἠγάπησεν ἡμᾶς.
verses.literal: We ourselves love because He himself first loved us.
verses.dgt: We love because he first loved us.

verses.greek: ἐάν τις εἴπῃ ὅτι Ἀγαπῶ τὸν θεόν, καὶ τὸν ἀδελφὸν αὐτοῦ μισῇ, ψεύστης ἐστίν· ὁ γὰρ μὴ ἀγαπῶν τὸν ἀδελφὸν αὐτοῦ ὃν ἑώρακεν, τὸν θεὸν ὃν οὐχ ἑώρακεν οὐ δύναται ἀγαπᾶν.
verses.literal: If anyone shall say that I love the God and the brother of him may hate a liar he is The one for not loving the brother of him whom he has seen the God whom not he has seen not is he able to love
verses.dgt: If anyone says, “I love God,” and hates his brother, he is a liar; for the one who does not love his brother whom he has seen cannot love God whom he has not seen.

verses.greek: καὶ ταύτην τὴν ἐντολὴν ἔχομεν ἀπʼ αὐτοῦ, ἵνα ὁ ἀγαπῶν τὸν θεὸν ἀγαπᾷ καὶ τὸν ἀδελφὸν αὐτοῦ.
verses.literal: And this the commandment we have from Him that the one loving the God may love also the brother of him.
verses.dgt: And this commandment we have from him: that the one who loves God should also love his brother.
